stock.description: Xinjiang Xinxin Mining Industry Co., Ltd., alongside its various subsidiaries, undertakes a full scope of operations involving nonferrous metals, from their initial extraction and beneficiation to smelting, refining, and ultimate distribution. The enterprise primarily deals in nickel and copper, offering products such as nickel cathode and copper cathode. Its portfolio also extends to cobalt products, gold, silver, platinum, and palladium. The company maintains complete control over the Kalatongke nickel-copper mine in Fuyun County, Xinjiang, and holds investments in the Huangshandong, Huangshan, and Xiangshan nickel-copper mines, all situated within Hami, Xinjiang. Furthermore, it possesses stakes in two vanadium mines located in Shangnan, Shaanxi. Its exploratory endeavors have led to the identification of approximately eleven mineral-rich geological formations. Established in 1950, Xinjiang Xinxin Mining Industry Co., Ltd. is based in Urumqi, People's Republic of China.
